fields.name: displayName
fields.tooltip: Name shown in the debug menu and used to seed this spawner's random stream (so renaming reshuffles its layout).

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Tint of this spawner's debug rows.

fields.name: spacing
fields.tooltip: Metres of track between one spawn step and the next (min, max).

fields.name: startDistance
fields.tooltip: The first step lands between this distance and this plus the minimum spacing, so the launch stays clean.

fields.name: chance
fields.tooltip: Chance that a step spawns anything at all. 1 = every step.

fields.name: prefab
fields.tooltip: The repair orb's look, carrying a RepairOrb, modelled at 1 m across. Empty = a code-built translucent sphere (shellColor) round a glowing cross (crossColor).

fields.name: size
fields.tooltip: Diameter of the repair orb as a share of the pad width (a boost orb's is its definition's size multiplier).

fields.name: roadClearance
fields.tooltip: Gap between the visible road and the orb's LOWEST point (the bottom of its bob), along the track's up. The centre is placed from this and the orb's radius, so at any size the orb floats clear of the road — and, sitting just above it, is always in the ship's path.

fields.name: spinDegreesPerSecond
fields.tooltip: How fast the orb spins about the track's up, degrees per second. 0 = keeps its authored rotation.

fields.name: shellColor
fields.tooltip: Colour of the code-built orb's translucent shell (alpha = how see-through it is, so the cross shows inside).

fields.name: crossColor
fields.tooltip: Colour of the code-built orb's glowing cross.
